question: Babur defeated Mahmud Lodi and Sultan Nusrat Shah thus establishing Mughal rule in India in the Battle of ______ in 1529
solution:
The correct answer is __Ghaghra__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1529, Babur defeated Muhammad Lodi and Nusrat Shah on the banks of the River Ghaghara.
 
• Mughal rule was established in India in 1526 by Babur.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi in the first battle of Panipat on 21st April 1526 and made Agra his capital.
 
• In 1527, he defeated Rana Sanga of Mewar at Khanwa.
 
• The Tuzuk-i-babri is the autobiography of Babur in Turkish.
 
• He died at Agra in 1530.
 
• His tomb is in Kabul.
 
• His original name was Zahir-ud-din-muhammad.
 
• He was from the Barlas tribe.
